pullRequest.title: [KrroodSpatialMath] Part 1: Move the semantic digital twin's spatial types into a new krrood_spatial_math[casadi]

nodes.body: very cool, thank your for taking your time doing this! I like the direction we are going in with the domain models, it will make all frameworks super slim at some point 😎 🥳
`A value in the same space as this frame`
well we don't have a Space yet in this PR, so I guess when we add the space?
i'd rather change it right away. i still think it's more understandable than the old one and this way we don't forget
ok
i get that you want to keep the interface the same, but i don't like this reexport. i'd rather break all imports
I agree, especially since all imports are being touched by the move anyways. Would you mind cleanring this init?
yeah I also wasn't sure, so I left it for you guys to comment on that.
so as aconsequence now it is 425 haha, but I think it is the right call as well.
please document the params 🙏
will do
Done
do you think it makes sense to make this a generic? that would help with typing
you mean the name field type?
yes, since its just any rn
Done

i dont like this naming, can this mabe be sth like "transform_in_own_frame" or sth? or also "express_in_own_frame"? that would make it easier to understand, i was a bit confused tbh.
also do you think it makes sense to bind ValueT to CartesianFrame3d?
I like `express_in_own_frame`.
done
just curious, why does this need to be overridden here? shouldnt this be the default thats already happening? is a bit sus claude does this
hmm yeah that's wierd haha
would you mind asking claude why it did that? :D

**claude**: dataset/frames.py:56 (override): “It was needed because the resolver passes the name and the tracker’s get didn’t accept it. DeserializedObjectTracker.get now takes name and reports it in UntrackedObjectError, so the override is gone, and so is SemDT’s.”
so I guess just to override the parameters accepted to the method
unless im mistaken, resolver doesnt declare create_kwargs
ok will verify thanks
Corrected it.
i dont think this domain should know about semdt interfaces
true
Done
